name: Corrina Cross
title: Communication and professional development trainer
profile: Corrina is a communication and professional development trainer and executive coach with more than 25 years' experience in the Middle East and internationally. She has coached and trained managers for organisations including Unilever, HSBC, Mastercard, Zurich Insurance and the UK Foreign and Commonwealth Office, and has delivered globally as a qualified Mind Gym coach since 2012. She is a certified NLP Master Practitioner, DiSC facilitator and Inter-Cultural Intelligence facilitator.

bullets: Delivers interactive courses in presentation skills, negotiation, people skills for managers and cultural understanding
Member of Mind Gym's global coach faculty, delivering performance management, leadership development and change programmes for multinational clients
Among fewer than 20 coaches selected to deliver Unilever's global management development programme
Partners with HR and learning teams on management development, behavioural profiling and employee engagement programmes

career.role: Client servicing team leader, corporate communications

education.qual: Master Practitioner of NLP, Time Line Therapy and hypnosis
